sections.title: From ODEs to PDEs: A Visual Shift
lecture_lines: ODEs track a single path over time.
PDEs model change across space and time.
An ODE relates to a single variable.
A PDE relates to multiple independent variables.
Visually: a point moves versus a surface morphs.
animations: Display a single variable function y(t) with one derivative. Color: #FFFFFF.
Introduce a multi-variable function u(x, t) with partial derivatives. Color: #FFFF00.
Show a transition from ODE notation to PDE notation. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: Diffusion in Motion
lecture_lines: The Heat Equation models spatial diffusion.
Heat flows from hot to cold regions.
Concavity drives this thermal equalization process.
animations: Represent temperature distribution u(x, t). Color: #FF0000.
Visualize diffusion flow across the rod. Color: #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Ripples and Rhythm
lecture_lines: The Wave Equation tracks rhythmic oscillations.
Speed depends on the material's properties.
